doc.text:
An utility that analyze FlxSound,
can be used to make waveform or real-time audio visualizer.

fields.name: getByte

doc.text: Get bytes from an audio buffer with specified position and wordSize

params.buffer: The audio buffer to get byte from.
params.position: The specified position to get the byte from the audio buffer.
params.wordSize: How many bytes to get with to one byte (Usually it's bitsPerSample / 8 or bitsPerSample >> 3).

doc.returns: Byte from the audio buffer with specified position.

fields.name: getSpectrumFromFrequencies

doc.text: Gets spectrum from the frequencies with specified sample rate.

params.spectrum: The output for getting the values, to avoid memory leaks (Optional).
params.ratio: How much ratio for smoothen the values from the previous spectrum values (Optional, use FlxMath.getElapsedLerp(1 - ratio) to simulate web AnalyserNode.smoothingTimeConstant, 0.35 of smoothingTime works most of the time).
params.minDb: The minimum decibels to cap (Optional, default -63.0, -120 is pure silence).
params.maxDb: The maximum decibels to cap (Optional, default -10.0, Above 0 is not recommended).
params.minFreq: The minimum frequency to cap (Optional, default 20.0, Below 8.0 is not recommended).
params.maxFreq: The maximum frequency to cap (Optional, default 20000.0, Above 23000.0 is not recommended).

doc.returns: Output of spectrum/bars that ranges from 0 to 1.

fields.name: getLevels

doc.text:
Gets levels from an attached FlxSound from startPos, basically a minimized of frequencies.

deprecated, use getLevels instead.

params.levels: The output for getting the values, to avoid memory leaks (Optional).

fields.name: getFrequencies

doc.text: Gets frequencies from an attached sound from position.

params.gain: How much gain multiplier will it affect the output. (Optional, default 1.0).
params.window: The windowing function to use when passed.
params.frequencies: The output for getting the frequencies, to avoid memory leaks (Optional).

fields.name: analyze

doc.text: Analyzes an attached sound from startPos to endPos in milliseconds to get the amplitudes.

params.outOrOutMins: The output minimum value from the analyzer, indices is in channels (0 to -0.5 -> 0 to 0.5) (Optional, if outMax doesn't get passed in, it will be [min, max] with all channels combined instead).
params.outMaxs: The output maximum value from the analyzer, indices is in channels (Optional).

doc.returns: Output			of amplitude from given position.

fields.name: getSamples

doc.text: Gets samples from startPos with given length of samples.

params.mono: Merge all of the byte channels of samples in one channel instead (Optional).
params.channel: What channels to get from? (-1 == All Channels, Optional, this will be ignored if mono is enabled).
params.gain: How much gain multiplier will it affect the output. (Optional, default 1.0).
params.output: An Output that gets passed into this function, usually for to avoid memory leaks (Optional).
params.outputMerge: Merge with previous values (Optional, default false).
